user.title: Storage Monitor
user.description: Select filesystems visible to the Home Assistant process. This does not measure a remote NAS or the entire Supervisor host. Forecasting needs at least a day of regular samples; earlier history is not backfilled. The optional forecast sensor uses normal HA entity permissions and may be visible to household members.

abort.no_readable_sources: No readable filesystems in the HA process namespace.

error.source_changed: Source changed. Select an available filesystem again.
